curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Tasked with fratricide to save his youngest kin, Charlie enters the brutal Outback knowing any resolution demands blood.
curatedMovie.description: In 1880s Australia, a lawman gives renegade Charlie Burns a brutal ultimatum: track down and execute his fugitive older brother, or his captured younger brother will hang.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, deliberate, and fiercely suspenseful. A demanding frontier drama best taken in with full focus.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director John Hillcoat delivers a severe Australian Western where family loyalty and frontier justice collide in a sun-scorched moral crucible.
